usage: The phrase 用陽台 (jung6 joeng4 toi4) means 'use balcony' and is used when talking about activities done on or utilizing the balcony.
It can describe actions like placing plants, drying clothes, or relaxing on the balcony.
用陽台 is usually followed by verbs or nouns indicating what you do or place on the balcony, for example, 用陽台晾衫 (use balcony to dry clothes).
It is not a standalone noun but a verb phrase, so it needs an object or complement to be complete.
This phrase is quite common in daily conversations about home living and space usage.
